description: Maps Azure Retail Prices meter names to Sentinel/Log Analytics cost categories. The simplified Microsoft Sentinel meters (service 'Sentinel') price analysis and Log Analytics ingestion together and are used when the price list has them; the classic Log Analytics and Sentinel meters are the fallback for an older capture. Commitment tiers are read separately from the '<n> GB Commitment Tier Capacity Reservation' meters (a price a day). When the API returns more than one row for the same meter (a 0-priced 'included' row alongside a non-zero row), the cost calculator takes the MAX unit price across the rows.

categories.description: Simplified Microsoft Sentinel pay-as-you-go price per GB for the Analytics tier, covering Sentinel analysis and Log Analytics ingestion together.
Simplified Microsoft Sentinel price per GB for Basic logs.
Microsoft Sentinel price per GB for Auxiliary logs on a workspace not onboarded to the data lake.
Classic Log Analytics per-GB ingestion, added to SentinelPremium when the price list has no simplified Sentinel meter.
Classic Microsoft Sentinel per-GB analysis charge, layered on Log Analytics ingestion when the price list has no simplified Sentinel meter.
Basic Logs plan per-GB ingestion. Query-time billing for Basic plan is not modelled.
Auxiliary Logs plan per-GB ingestion. Query-time billing for Auxiliary plan is not modelled.
Sentinel data lake ingestion per GB, for tables on the data lake tier only (and Auxiliary tables once onboarded to the lake).
Sentinel data lake processing per GB, charged with data lake ingestion for tables on the data lake tier only.
Per-GB-month interactive retention beyond the default free interactive period.
